description.value:
Built for Biotechnica’s Reclamation Forest Protection Division (RFPD) in the 2040s, the Wheelbow incorporates rapid-cycling technology from top of the line revolvers into a special magazine that stores telescopic arrows. Akin to an IFV’s autoloader, the arrows are fed directly into the the bowstring, improving fire rate and overall lethality. While some worried the Wheelbow would become outdated, it’s aged like fine wine, as improvements in nanocarbon draw strings have made it an exceptionally powerful tool for deep-pocketed urban archers.

Cost: 4,000eb (Luxury)

Class: Excellent Quality Bow • Skill: Archery • Range: Bow

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 1/4 • ROF: 1/2 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Power Rebuild, Reinforced String, Smartgun Link • Mods: None

Special Features: Unlike other Bows, this weapon has a Drum Magazine which can hold up to 4 Arrows of any type. The Drum Magazine may be loaded with up to four different Ammunition Types simultaneously, with the user choosing which to use when firing the weapon. While the Drum Magazine has at least 2 Arrows stored within it, this weapon functions at ROF 2 instead of ROF 1, but can only fire arrows feeded from the Drum Magazine. Once the Drum Magazine is depleted, this weapon returns to functioning at ROF 1 with a Capacity of 1 until the Drum Magazine is replaced with 2 Reload Actions.

Range: Bow
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild, Reinforced String, Smartgun Link (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Listed capacity is 1/4; the sheet tracks 4.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
